digest.component_or_area: store lock ownership and timeout reporting
propositions: A compaction sweep holding the store write lock produces a bare pid in the LockTimeout message, hiding that the holder is interruptible and safe to SIGTERM.
The sweep's lock acquisition at _compact_locked does not label its operation, so blocked writers cannot distinguish it from an ordinary writer without external tooling like lsof.
An ambient operation_label contextvar mechanism can propagate the label to _owner_stamp without modifying the acquisition call site in compact_txn.py.
The op= field must be colon-free and sanitized to preserve v2 lock stamp format compatibility and forward-compatible parsing.
The LockTimeout message should state that a compact-sweep holder is safe to interrupt and that the next trigger will re-fold skipped events.
